name: threadTerminate
description: Terminates the thread specified by the threadName parameter.

coldfusion.notes: Still listed by getFunctionList() in ColdFusion 2025, but calling it throws "Method ThreadTerminate no longer supported." Use interruptThread() instead.

lucee.notes: In Lucee the default for threadname parameter is "run" and the terminated thread scope will have an error object included after termination.
